name: Almon Rutherford
source:
Faction:	Terran
Birthday:	May 7, 2378
Place of Birth:	Neo Hampshire
Occupation:	Head Engineer and Systems Developer of the Sierra
Affiliation:	United Terran Vanguard

Profile:
Lieutenant Almon Rutherford is, without question, one of the most important assets of the UTV.

Rutherford is one of the brilliant hand-picked engineers who took part in developing the Blitzkrieg (Admiral Peterson’s Capital Ship), Lapis Units (ship-of-the-line class frigates of the UTV), and Sierra’s systems.

He currently serves as chief engineer aboard the Sierra.
